systems.country_label: the information system of the Institut national de santé publique (INSP), under its digitalisation strategy
systems.owner: Institut national de santé publique, with the Ministry of Health's directorate of informatics and information systems; WHO support
systems.tiers: not stated; a group of INSP file managers and IT specialists trained on the platform

note: The one passage carrying a term says the INSP is carrying out a three-year digitalisation strategy with the Ministry of Health's IT directorate and WHO support, and that an INSP group has been trained on DHIS2 by a WHO expert; it names the platform without describing what it reports, so the system is unclassified and gives no fact.
